message: So the other day, I was whipping up my famous chili (or so I like to think) when I noticed that my smoke alarm was blinking a little too much for my comfort. I took a moment to check it, and sure enough, it needed new batteries. I swapped them out, and just a few minutes later, my chili was bubbling away without a hitch. It felt like a small win, but it reminded me how those little checks can really save the day. Have you had a small win in your home safety routine lately?
